accountability_unit_type.dispute: A native dispute or a vote/payment event linked to a dispute; consult event_granularity.
accountability_unit_type.individual_report: One native report or authenticated update; not a unique independent real-world fact.
accountability_unit_type.publisher_pool_epoch: Pyth publisher epoch, stake instruction or reward transfer; native granularity remains essential.
accountability_unit_type.reporter_jail_lifecycle: Tellor jail/release event; two rows may belong to one restriction lifecycle.
accountability_unit_type.request: One oracle request round, identified by the native request ID.
accountability_unit_type.reward_epoch: A provider, beneficiary or claim observation linked to a protocol reward epoch.
accountability_unit_type.service_availability_window: Chainlink service interval or staking action; consult native_table and event_granularity.
accountability_unit_type.staking_position: DIA withdrawal against a native staking position index.
accountability_unit_type.voting_request: Voter-level accrual linked to a DVM request; multiple voters share the request ID.

mapping_rules.uma_oov2_unsettled_request_observation_v: A retained UMA request has economic_status=not_settled. The rule records request observability only; it does not establish settlement, a realized payment or report correctness.

truth_basis.consensus_median_alignment: Agreement with the protocol aggregate, not an independent reference.
truth_basis.cryptographic_validation_and_challenge: Chronicle validation/challenge mechanism; factual truth is not independently observed.
truth_basis.external_ground_truth: Independent factual label requiring its own source and validation.
truth_basis.independent_reference_adjudication: Adjudication against an explicitly identified independent reference; not inferred from a transfer.
truth_basis.protocol_aggregate: Tellor native report/aggregate inclusion; does not certify the report as true.
truth_basis.protocol_recognized_reporting: Tellor report recognized for a payment; recognition is not external truth.
truth_basis.protocol_state_transition: Observed Pyth stake/transfer state transition without independent factual adjudication.
truth_basis.protocol_vote_adjudication: Protocol voting outcome, not independent factual ground truth.
truth_basis.service_availability_condition: Recorded service or eligibility condition, without a factual truth judgment.
truth_basis.signed_payload_verification: RedStone authenticated payload evidence; signatures authenticate a source, not the price.
truth_basis.staking_participation_not_individual_rep: DIA staking withdrawal evidence, with no individual report correctness label.
truth_basis.undisputed_acceptance: Protocol acceptance without adjudication; does not establish factual truth.
